conclusion.capability: Moving the reference field sideways makes the unrestricted 1.767492-degree R1 rotation survive the complete native KiCad gate and ladder rematerialization.
conclusion.quality: The recovered rotational freedom does not improve route length on this rung; both repaired unrestricted proposals are worse than their nearby-courtyard controls.
conclusion.negative_result: The first alternate merely moves the collision from R1 to R3, and the fourth inherited action duplicates the first for this axis-aligned source pose.
conclusion.architecture: Keep source-checked reference placements in durable candidates and enumerate/deduplicate them as discrete DRC-driven actions. Do not assume the first alternate is valid, and do not fold movable documentation into permanent body separation.
conclusion.next_gap: The CLI exposes individual actions, but a coordinator does not yet enumerate, native-gate, retain, score, and select the unique alternatives automatically.
